purpose: Show or hide supplementary content through its owning trigger.
basis: Native source page 72:2724 (Collapsible), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: open/defaultOpen control one panel. Disabled suppresses toggling. onOpenChange carries the boolean and cancellable source details. Closing changes panel presence according to Panel keepMounted/transition options; the caller restores focus before programmatically hiding a currently focused descendant if required.
keyboardAndFocus: The native trigger uses Enter/Space and normal Tab order. Escape/outside press do not close a bare Collapsible. There is no modal focus trap or automatic focus-return contract.
referenceDecisions: One stable trigger/content ownership relation per shown instance; concrete labels and task children are caller supplied. Exact wrapper types retain optional handles/payloads/placement overrides. Complete describes this sufficient reference, not a full application/platform certification.
